title: OpenAPIDocument
description: A root-level API description that declares one OpenAPI version and binds together exactly one Info object, one Paths map, and optionally servers, components, root security requirements, tags and external docs, describing a single API surface. One instance exists per openapi.yaml/json file or per generated spec endpoint, not per path, operation or reusable component. Use Info instead when the element is only the title/version/description/contact/license metadata block, not the whole specification. Use Paths instead when the element is only the map of URL path templates to PathItems inside a document. Use Components instead when the element is the reusable-definitions registry (schemas, responses, securitySchemes, etc.), even if it lives in a separate shared file referenced via $ref. Use PathItem instead when the element describes the operations under one URL path rather than the whole API.

openapi.description: The OpenAPI Specification version the document conforms to, as a semantic version string (e.g. '3.0.3'); always set, and distinct from the API's own version in Info.

info.description: Reference to the single api.info node holding the API's title, version and metadata; always set because Info is required.

servers.description: Reference(s) to api.server nodes giving the base URLs where the API is deployed; set when the spec declares root-level servers, otherwise tooling defaults to '/'.

paths.description: Required per OpenAPI 3.0 but may be an empty object ({}) when the document is used solely to define reusable components.

components.description: Reference to the api.components node holding reusable schemas, responses, parameters and security schemes; set when the document defines any reusable objects.

security.description: Defines default security requirements applied to all operations. Individual operations can override or remove it by setting their own 'security' to an empty array ([]).

tags.description: Ordered reference list of root-level api.tag nodes that supply descriptions and external docs for tag names used by operations; set when the spec declares a root tags array.

externalDocs.description: Reference to an api.externaldocumentation node linking to supplementary documentation for the whole API; set only when the spec declares root-level externalDocs.

x-dr-evidence: a file such as openapi.yaml, openapi.json or swagger/v3 spec whose top-level key is 'openapi: 3.0.x' alongside 'info' and 'paths'
framework spec bootstrap code, e.g. FastAPI(title=..., version=...), springdoc OpenAPI bean, swagger-jsdoc definition object, or NSwag/Swashbuckle AddSwaggerGen document registration
an HTTP route serving the generated spec (e.g. GET /openapi.json, /v3/api-docs) or a Swagger UI/Redoc config pointing at that URL, or an openapi-generator input path in build config

x-dr-distinguish.api.info: the element is only the title/version/description/contact/license metadata block, not the whole specification.
x-dr-distinguish.api.paths: the element is only the map of URL path templates to PathItems inside a document.
x-dr-distinguish.api.components: the element is the reusable-definitions registry (schemas, responses, securitySchemes, etc.), even if it lives in a separate shared file referenced via $ref.
x-dr-distinguish.api.pathitem: the element describes the operations under one URL path rather than the whole API.
